arguments.code: $page = 1; $audited = 0; $missing = []; do { $batch = $tools->call("publishing_list", ["page" => $page]); foreach ($batch->items as $article) { ++$audited; if (trim($article->meta_description) === "") { $missing[] = $article->id; } } $page = $batch->nextPage; } while ($page !== null); sort($missing); return ["audited" => $audited, "missing" => $missing];
